value.rationale: Complete natural rank spectrum of associative derivations satisfying composition idempotence over an unrestricted family M_n(F_q). The characteristic-two nonsplit quadratic field orbit is structurally different from matrix projections, exists exactly in even dimensions, has Frobenius-semilinear image of exactly half the algebra, and yields a distinct explicit finite-field conjugacy-class multiplicity. These are not arbitrary small slices.
